stem: Which SOP instruction is most executable for a cultivation technician?
choices: Watch the plants and use good judgment
Record room temperature and RH at the defined interval; if either value is outside the supplied operating range, follow the listed escalation step
Keep conditions perfect throughout the day
rationale: Executable procedure steps describe observable actions, required records and what to do when expected conditions are not met rather than relying on vague verbs or unwritten judgment.
